+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from numbers import Number
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def mapping_value_kind_counts(mapping: Mapping[Any, object]) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Count mapping values by kind, including kinds that are absent."""
+    counts = {"null": 0, "bool": 0, "number": 0, "text": 0, "other": 0}
+    for _, value in mapping.items():
+        if value is None:
+            kind = "null"
+        elif isinstance(value, bool):
+            kind = "bool"
+        elif isinstance(value, Number):
+            kind = "number"
+        elif isinstance(value, str):
+            kind = "text"
+        else:
+            kind = "other"
+        counts[kind] += 1
+    return counts

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from types import MappingProxyType
+
+from _pytest.mapping_value_kind_counts import mapping_value_kind_counts
+
+
+def test_mapping_value_kind_counts() -> None:
+    mapping = MappingProxyType(
+        {
+            "null": None,
+            "true": True,
+            "false": False,
+            "integer": 0,
+            "float": 1.5,
+            "complex": 1j,
+            "text": "",
+            "bytes": b"text",
+            "list": [None],
+        }
+    )
+
+    assert mapping_value_kind_counts(mapping) == {
+        "null": 1,
+        "bool": 2,
+        "number": 3,
+        "text": 1,
+        "other": 2,
+    }
+
+
+def test_mapping_value_kind_counts_empty() -> None:
+    assert mapping_value_kind_counts({}) == {
+        "null": 0,
+        "bool": 0,
+        "number": 0,
+        "text": 0,
+        "other": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def test_mapping_value_kind_counts_does_not_render() -> None:
+    class Unrenderable:
+        def __repr__(self) -> str:
+            raise AssertionError("mapping entries must not be rendered")
+
+        __str__ = __repr__
+
+    assert mapping_value_kind_counts({Unrenderable(): Unrenderable()}) == {
+        "null": 0,
+        "bool": 0,
+        "number": 0,
+        "text": 0,
+        "other": 1,
+    }
notes:
The implementation counts all five kinds in one pass over mapping items, checking bool before Number without rendering entries. Focused tests cover mixed and empty mappings and entries that cannot be rendered.
